title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 39,663 Official Dossiers Across 37 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 39,663 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 853 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 37 active jurisdictions: United States (15,295 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (2,725 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,378 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (4,445 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,966 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (182 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,270 dossiers | Catalog), International (994 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (167 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (189 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (66 dossiers | Catalog), France (418 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (71 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (76 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (365 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (25 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (85 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (90 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (32 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (47 dossiers | Catalog), China (31 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (150 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (40 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (38 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (14 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (26 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
